description: Edit an existing Radix Wiki page. Requires a ROLA bearer token; see https://radix.wiki/AGENTS.md. Read the page with get_page and `blocks: true`, send the full revised block array, and pass its `version` as baseVersion: an edit made after someone else's is refused rather than written over it, so read again and reapply. The version bump, block-level diff, and revision entry are computed server-side. Needs a wallet holding at least 20,000 $XRD (ideas 10,000). Locked and author-only pages are rejected. Earns contribution points.

bannerImage.description: Banner image URL; an empty string removes it

baseVersion.description: The `version` get_page returned, which this edit starts from

content.description: The full revised block array (not a patch). Omit to change only the title or metadata.

items.description: A typed block with a unique `id` (UUID) and a `type`. A `content` block carries semantic HTML in `text`; an `infobox` carries nested `blocks`. For any other type, copy the shape of one already on a page: get_page with `blocks: true` (or GET /api/wiki/{path}) returns blocks as stored.

pageIds.description: Page ids in display order (pageList): the `id` get_page returns with `blocks: true`

editorIds.description: User ids who may co-edit an author-only page. Applied only when the author sends it.

metadata.description: Replacement metadata object: the whole `metadata` get_page returns with `blocks: true`, revised

newSlug.description: Move the page to this slug (an article only)

revisionMessage.description: What changed and why — shown in the page history. Always send one.

slug.description: Slug of the page to edit

tagPath.description: Tag path of the page to edit

verified.description: True when you checked the page's facts against its sources: stamps lastVerifiedAt. Send it alone to stamp without an edit.

name: edit_page
title: Edit a page
